I don't have any photos of you at the beach here. 

All five photographs I hold are from your winter family trip to Sikkim and Gangtok: *A stop on the way up*, *The last morning*, *Cloud coming up the valley*, *Alone on the forest road*, and *The three of us under Kanchenjunga*. 

Would you like to build a short film from those mountain memories instead?
